description: This is a Java source file implementing an FTP client class 'SimpleFtpClient' that provides methods for connecting to an FTP server, listing files, setting transfer modes, uploading files, and closing the connection.

classes.name: SimpleFtpClient
classes.description: A class that manages FTP connections and operations, implementing the FtpClientInterface.

methods.name: SimpleFtpClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FTP client object.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an FTP connection using provided hostname, credentials, port, and timeout. Throws exceptions if unable to connect or login.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists files in the specified directory on the FTP server.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Sets the transfer mode to binary or ASCII.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Configures FTP connection to passive or active mode.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Uploads a file to the specified directory with the given filename.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the FTP connection if active.
